name: steer@10
after: steer@9 (PR 1817): steer@8's 52 held-out designs and the zero design; steer@8's 64 training prompts and steer@9's two halves of 32 fresh prompts

measures.arith: log10 of the mean over prompts of the soft rate, plus the floor (every round so far)
measures.geo: the mean over prompts of log10 of the prompt's soft rate plus the floor

change: a design's change on a concept is its measure minus the zero design's, on the same prompts

claims.reliability: for at least 3 of the 4 panel concepts, the correlation across the 52 designs between their changes on half a and on half b is higher under geo than under arith
claims.transfer: for at least 3 of the 4 panel concepts, the correlation across the designs between their changes on the training prompts and on the 64 fresh prompts is higher under geo than under arith
claims.reported: both measures' median worst-concept gaps (half a - half b, training - fresh), slopes and offsets from training to fresh, the spread of the changes across designs, and the arith figures beside steer@9's (the same designs and prompts, read again)
